title: Explicit Retry resumes only the exact owned failed chain generation and preserves historical records
steps: Run the handoff integration suite against a scratch PostgreSQL database with TEST_DATABASE_URL set.
expect: A historical completed action with an owned current failed chain brief can accept one explicit Retry, preserving its site, frozen revision, old action and QA during restart.
Request replay returns the same action; a failed child Retry obtains fresh authority for its newly failed brief.

An applied terminal soft failure grants explicit full-chain retry authority only when its latest write failed and no steps are running; its site and frozen revision stay unchanged while new inputs are prepared.

Healthy applied, successful latest write, missing or malformed measurements, running steps, ready, replaced, unowned, wrong-revision, open-turn, QA-lease, live-writer and lost-placement briefs do not grant recovery authority.
An atomic restart refuses changed snapshots, changed applied write measurements, replaced sites, revoked owners, live writers and forged authority; missing terminal measurements never pass QA.
fence: Server-held action authority and an atomic comparison of the exact failed brief generation

tests: an explicit historical chain Retry preserves the old verdict and resumes the same failed generation once
a failed child Retry receives fresh authority for its own failed chain generation
an applied soft failure with a failed write explicitly restarts the same chain with a new generation
accepted applied chain Retry refuses a changed terminal write measurement before restarting
a done host build without the chain measurement cannot hand over as QA passed
